source.title: Goblinomics v1.3.0 release changelog (v1.0.1 and v1.0.2 Salvage history)
source.author: xLN

notes: NEW primary-code and author-release acquisition lead, not a numeric drop cohort. Original author changelog dated 2026-10-04 says Workshop > Salvage records number of disenchants per item and dust/shards received; v1.0.2 consolidates variants of the same item in list rows. Current v1.3.0 release explicitly supports Retail 12.1.5/12.1.0. The original GitHub README at https://github.com/xLN1995/goblinomics/blob/main/README.md says Salvage also covers milling and prospecting and data remain in local SavedVariables. No player SavedVariables, per-cast 0-inclusive outcome ledger, exact 272246 itemLink/ilvl, 237362/237359/237365 input ranks, 236761 milling outcomes, material item IDs/quality, profession skill/spec, Resourcefulness, castsWithDrop, histograms, or patch-at-operation evidence were publicly provided. The fact that the addon has local accounting aggregates does not prove it logs per-operation data. Never promote this source to measured rates or import counts without original player output and schema/source-code validation.
